en.primary_text: You start the day with the sun on the hood and a flatbed load behind you. Dispatch Freight Lines pays $0.68 to $0.74 per mile, Midwest to the Southeast. Plus a $3,000 sign-on bonus. Age 23+.
en.headline: $3,000 sign-on bonus

en.primary_text: Out 10 to 12 days on over-the-road flatbed runs, Midwest to the Southeast. You get health insurance and a 401k. Dispatch Freight Lines is family-run, and dispatch picks up when you call.
